title: search_logs arguments

source.description: wazuh = authentication / sudo / account events (login outcome); tshark = TCP sessions (volume, timing, bytes; SSH is encrypted, so no login outcome); all = both.

account.description: account name such as j.mehta (letters, digits and . _ @ -)

host.description: host name such as fin-app-01, or its IPv4 address

event_type.description: auth_failure / auth_success = login attempts (Wazuh); privilege = sudo; account_change = new or changed local accounts; network_session = tshark TCP sessions; any = no filter.

start.description: an ISO 8601 UTC time such as 2026-11-18T09:30:00Z (inclusive)

end.description: an ISO 8601 UTC time such as 2026-11-18T10:00:00Z (inclusive)

limit.description: maximum events returned (1-200, default 50); the earliest matching events are returned first

errorMessage: give at least one filter besides source: account, host, src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port, start, end, or an event_type other than any
